findings.location: Project ID — “The seed and the first-seen record” (line 186); Acceptance criteria (lines 401–402)
findings.problem: The spec says nothing reads `seen` yet, but also requires a project reused at a different path or remote to be treated as new. This makes the stated current safety behavior internally contradictory; the implementation does read and compare the path record for acknowledgement-gated operations.
findings.suggestion: Update the implementation-status statement to describe the current path comparison and its operation scope, and clearly defer remote comparison until implemented.

findings.location: Owner classes and Operations/adopt; the two adopt acceptance criteria
findings.problem: A document marked “Current” and owner-approved includes adoption rules explicitly labeled “proposed” and “my call.” Under the repository policy, those author choices are not owner-approved specification behavior, yet they are presented as normative operations and acceptance criteria.
findings.suggestion: Move the unapproved adoption material to a candidate or plan, or obtain and record owner approval before treating it as part of this current spec.

summary: The spec mixes unapproved adoption behavior into a current spec and contains a material contradiction about first-seen enforcement.
